name: doro

blend.prompt: Integrate doro (simple orange-pink round meme creature, blank cute eyes, chubby, meme style) naturally into the user's real-life photo. Match scene lighting. Cozy, soft, semi-realistic blend.
blend.negativePrompt: blurry, scary, extra limbs, text, watermark, realistic human

rarityModifiers.普通: Lying or sitting quietly at corner, small and mellow.
rarityModifiers.稀有: Slightly larger, gentle orange glow, relaxed pose.
rarityModifiers.传说: Warm focal point, dreamy atmosphere, orange accent light.
